name: council-of-models-mcp

tools.name: ask_openai
tools.description: Send a prompt to OpenAI via API (requires OPENAI_API_KEY). Default model: gpt-5.4 (Best overall model. Strong coding, reasoning, and tool use.). Available models: gpt-5.4-pro, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-nano

prompt.description: The prompt to send to OpenAI

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to set the context/role for the model

model.description: Model to use. Defaults to gpt-5.4. Options: gpt-5.4-pro, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-nano

reasoning_effort.description: Controls how much reasoning effort the model spends. "high" = more thorough but slower/costlier.

tools.name: ask_codex
tools.description: Send a prompt to OpenAI via the locally-installed Codex CLI (no API key needed — uses codex login). Default model: gpt-5.4 (Best overall model via local Codex CLI. Uses your Codex login — no API key costs.). Available models: gpt-5.4-pro, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-nano

prompt.description: The prompt to send to Codex CLI

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to set the context/role for the model

model.description: Model to use. Defaults to gpt-5.4. Options: gpt-5.4-pro, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-nano

tools.name: ask_gemini
tools.description: Send a prompt to Google Gemini and get a response. Default model: gemini-3.1-pro-preview (Flagship model for complex reasoning, agentic workflows, and deep context.). Thinking is enabled at "high" level by default. Available models: gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview

prompt.description: The prompt to send to Gemini

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to set the context/role for the model

model.description: Model to use. Defaults to gemini-3.1-pro-preview. Options: gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview

tools.name: ask_all
tools.description: Send the same prompt to TWO providers in parallel and compare responses. Use mode "codex" (default) for Codex CLI + Gemini — no OpenAI API costs. Use mode "openai" for OpenAI API + Gemini. If one provider fails, the other's response is still returned. Ideal for the /council workflow.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to both providers

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt applied to both providers

mode.description: Which provider to pair with Gemini. "codex" (default) = local Codex CLI, free. "openai" = OpenAI API, requires API key.

openai_model.description: OpenAI API model override (only used in "openai" mode). Default: gpt-5.4

codex_model.description: Codex CLI model override (only used in "codex" mode). Default: gpt-5.4

openai_reasoning_effort.description: OpenAI reasoning effort (only used in "openai" mode).

stderr: [council-mcp] Server running on stdio (OpenAI API + Codex CLI + Gemini API)
